Hi team,

Quick technical assessment - short version:

- Dedicated capacity (Redwood Dedicated) provides logical tenant isolation and dedicated GPU pools for a customer. Network isolation options we can offer:
  * Private routing via AWS PrivateLink or VPC peering to minimize internet egress.
  * Restrict egress with strict firewall rules and NAT controls on our side.
  * Bring-your-own-KMS support for encrypting model data at rest using customer keys (depends on provider and HSM requirements).

- Limitations of Dedicated:
  * Infrastructure is still managed by Redwood (we operate the compute) - hardware-level multi-tenancy can remain unless we provision a physically isolated cluster (special request, longer lead time).
  * For customers who require full network ownership (run inside their AWS account) or full hardware isolation, our Private VPC/on-prem deployment is the recommended option.

- Private VPC (VPC or on-prem):
  * Customer manages the network and KMS; no outbound egress from your VPC unless you configure it.
  * Supports strict compliance controls and HSM integrations; can meet "no egress" and customer-managed KMS requirements.
  * Longer lead time and additional licensing/ops costs.

Recommended next steps for FinSecure:
1) 60-minute technical workshop to validate CIDRs, proxy requirements, and KMS/HSM needs (I can lead).
2) Decide whether a physically isolated Dedicated cluster is acceptable or if Private VPC is required.
3) If Private VPC, provide timeline expectations (planning + provisioning typically 6-10 weeks for first deployment) and initial sizing.

I've attached a quick design sketch and links to our compliance docs.

Regards,
